mechanism_claims.claim_text: AOD causes bacterial membrane damage/permeabilization in S. epidermidis G-81 based on PI/SYTO9 fluorescence staining after AOD treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Qualitative imaging support; no exact cell-count percentage is promoted from the figure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AOD alters membrane fluidity/stiffening in S. epidermidis G-81, with GP-value changes reported under 1x to 4x MIC treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanistic interpretation is bounded to membrane-fluidity assay context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AOD perturbs intracellular ATP/metabolic state in S. epidermidis G-81, with fold increases reported after 1x, 2x, and 4x MIC treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: ATP increase is preserved as metabolic disruption evidence, not as a sole lethal mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AOD increases reactive oxygen species signal in S. epidermidis G-81 in DCFH-DA measurements under MIC-multiple treatments.
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS evidence is source-supported but should not be generalized beyond the reported S. epidermidis G-81 assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AOD has source-supported antibiofilm activity against S. epidermidis G-81, including MBIC/MBEC and primary/mature biofilm inhibition measurements.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Anti-biofilm measurements are activity evidence; they are not over-promoted to a molecular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The intact disulfide-bond pattern of AOD is required for stronger antibacterial activity relative to AOD-1/AOD-2/AOD-3 mutants.
